name: emeraldwf
setup: Add 'emeraldwf' to the plugins list in [core] of your wayfire config, then restart wayfire (or toggle the plugin off/on in WCM). Configure in WCM (Plugins > Emerald Decoration). The theme editor (emerald-theme-manager) is built in the manager build dir; ./install.sh installs the full layout (plugin + engines + editor + WCM metadata) with a safe user-dir fallback.
